newsitem.title: USA: Delta Financial moves IPO price range higher.
newsitem.headline: Delta Financial moves IPO price range higher.

text.p: Delta Financial Corp raised the estimated price range for its planned initial public offering to $14.50 to $16.50 a share from its previous range of $14 to $16, according to a regulatory filing.

Delta has filed to offer four million shares which would trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol DFC.N. The company is a specialty consumer finance company that buys and sells home equity loans for individuals with troubled credit profiles.
